title: Signs of a sublet scam in SF

entries.query_str: signs a sf sublet listing is a scam. guy wants deposit via zelle before showing, says hes abroad
entries.answer:
That combination hits the **two biggest red flags** [1][2]: the "landlord" is unavailable/abroad, and they want money via a non-reversible method (Zelle, wire, crypto, gift cards) **before you see the place**. Other common signs:
- Rent well below market for the area.
- Photos that appear on other listings (reverse-image search them).
- Pressure to decide fast; refusal to video-call from inside the unit.
- No lease or a generic template with no address details [2].

Don't send money. Ask for a live video walkthrough and verify ownership (county property records) before any payment, and use a method with buyer protection [1].
